meaning.en: (oncology) A fibroblastic sarcoma: a malignant tumor derived from fibrous connective tissue.
meaning.vi: (Ung thư học) Sarcoma nguyên bào sợi: một khối u ác tính có nguồn gốc từ mô liên kết dạng sợi.

sentences.en: The CMN is histologically similar to fibrosarcoma or Leiomyoma.

sentences.en: Angiosarcoma and fibrosarcoma has poor prognosis.

sentences.en: Diagnostic criteria of leiomyosarcoma, fibrosarcoma, non Hodgkin′s lymphoma of the prostate are the same as their counterparts in the soft tissue.

sentences.en: Congenital - infantile fibrosarcoma is a rare tumor with which clinicians should be familiar.

sentences.en: Objective To analyse CT appearances of fibroma and fibrosarcoma and to provide evidences for clinical diagnosis and treatment.

sentences.en: It is necessary to differentiate from fibrosarcoma, synovial sarcoma, metastatic adenocarcinoma etc, morphologically.

sentences.en: Most of these non-lipogenic elements appear like fibrosarcoma or MFH, and often display features of high grade sarcoma.

sentences.en: Its clinical course differs from conventional fibrosarcoma , the prognosis is usually good and the 5- year survival rate can be more than 80%.
